project_type: Flutter mobile app (RepGate) - Health Tracker + Push-up enforced app lock system with Supabase backend
build_system: Flutter CLI + Supabase CLI for edge functions. No Makefile. pubspec.yaml manages Dart deps.
test_framework: flutter_test SDK (no test files exist currently). Dart analysis via analysis_options.yaml.
build_command: flutter analyze lib/ (static analysis since no device/emulator available)
verification_instructions: 1. Run flutter analyze lib/ to ensure no errors. 2. Verify new files are properly imported. 3. Check that Supabase migration SQL is syntactically valid.
setup_instructions: Flutter SDK 3.32+ required. Run flutter pub get. Supabase project needs SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_ANON_KEY dart-defines.
environment_constraints: Flutter SDK not installed in sandbox. Verification limited to AST/syntax validation using dart analyze if available, or manual code review. No device/emulator for UI testing. Network mode allows package installs.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Code follows existing patterns: Provider for state, FirestoreService (now Supabase-backed) for data, Edge Functions for server-authoritative logic, AppTheme/AppColors for styling.
key_patterns: 1. Services are stateless singletons provided via Provider. 2. Screens use context.select for fine-grained rebuilds. 3. Widgets use SoftCard, PillButton, CircleIconButton, SectionHeader consistently. 4. Dark mode uses AppColors.darkBg/darkCard/darkBorder. 5. Edge Functions use _shared/common.ts patterns (invoke, requireUser, adminClient). 6. Models have fromMap/toMap factories. 7. The PUSHUP constant in _shared/pushup.ts has unlockHours: 24 (will need tiered changes). 8. FirestoreService is named for legacy reasons but backs onto Supabase Postgres.
directory_structure: lib/ - Flutter app code (main.dart, models/, providers/, screens/, services/, utils/, widgets/). supabase/ - Backend (migrations/, functions/ with 13+ edge functions and _shared/ utilities). assets/images/ - App assets. android/ - Android platform code.
